questions.q: Exercise Tiger Triumph 2026 is a bilateral tri-service humanitarian assistance and disaster relief (HADR) exercise between India and which country?
questions.exam: Common MPSC; Inspector of Taxes; DSC LDA
questions.source: PIB Ministry of Defence release dated 3 November 2026; corroborating reporting
questions.verificationStatus: Original practice item; checked against dated primary or reputable source; not an official PYQ.
questions.e: Tiger Triumph is the India–United States tri-service HADR exercise. The 2026 edition involved joint planning and coordination centred on Visakhapatnam. It improves interoperability during disaster response, not conventional combat.

questions.q: The 9th High-Level Meeting between the Indian Coast Guard and Sri Lanka Coast Guard on 3 November 2026 was held at which place?

questions.topic: India S&T Scoreboard and Meghalaya research output
questions.q: The India S&T Scoreboard launched by NITI Aayog in November 2026 is designed to provide an integrated view of which areas across States and Union Territories?
questions.exam: Common MPSC; Inspector of Taxes; DSC LDA
questions.source: NITI Aayog India S&T Scoreboard; data checked 4 November 2026
questions.verificationStatus: Original practice item; checked against dated primary or reputable source; not an official PYQ.
questions.e: The scoreboard combines research-publication, patent and ecosystem indicators. FY2024-25 data show 223,005 Indian research publications and 62,934 patent applications. Meghalaya is listed with 1,144 publications, rank 26 among 36 States/UTs for this indicator only.
